## Agentic photo sourcing + enhancement (OpenRouter)

**Agent 1 - Agentic Image Search**: given search_images/search_web/fetch_page tools, decides what to search and open, then calls select_images with up to 3 DISTINCT real photos. Candidates are only accepted if their URL actually appeared in a tool result during the conversation (rejects hallucinated URLs), then each is live-verified with a real HTTP fetch before being trusted.

**Agent 2 - Agentic Image Enhancer**: for each selected photo, asks a Gemini image model (via OpenRouter) to sharpen/color-correct/de-noise WITHOUT altering the product itself, then a second model judges the result (same product? better quality?) and retries with feedback if it fails - accepts nothing it has not judged first. Watermark removal is intentionally out of scope (the model correctly refuses it on copyrighted editorial photos - see chat).

Tested live 2026-09-23 against Sony WH-1000XM6 - see chat for the actual before/after image.

Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the n8n container environment (docker-compose.yml).
